text: Book an endoscopy, which is a camera test of the food pipe and stomach, because your acidity or indigestion has lasted for 190 days [1]. A safe window for this symptom is 42 days, so your symptoms have lasted longer than expected [1]. You should also be tested for the stomach bacterium *H. pylori* [1]. When you visit the health centre, tell them how long your symptoms have lasted, what treatments you have already tried, and that the treatments have not worked [4].
